name: Eastside vs Seattle Homes: Different Floors, Different Problems
title-tag: Eastside vs Seattle Floors: A Bellevue Comparison
meta-description: Seattle floors are old, soft fir; Eastside floors are oak or engineered. What changes across the lake — thickness, wear layers, fade — and what it costs.
post-summary: March 10, 2027 · Seattle’s pre-war fir raises questions about how much wood is left; the Eastside’s oak and engineered plank raise questions about wear layers and factory coatings. A field guide to both sides of the lake — and why Bellevue contains both stories.
